title: ThanksGiving NFT
tagline: A on-chain career proof protocol generating Non-transferrable NFT with comments from one’s colleague. After logging in with Metamask, people can leave comments for their teammates. Everyone can generate an NFT in which comments and one’s role in the team are written.
description: Today, almost all of us are writing resumes to prove "who you are" and "what you are doing". However, people cannot judge if the applicant fits into their company only from the applicant’s resume. Therefore, you have to set up an interview and ask them about their experience in depth. That’s because we hacked the on-chain career proof protocol. Using this protocol, you can prove your role and your teammate’s evaluation.
how_its_made: We used React+Solidity to build this product. Using ERC721 contract and making them non-transferrable by adding validation when you hit the function "transfer". We built a function that can generate NFTs with information about people’s experiences in their metadata (turning texts into SVG files and adding them to metadata).
